question: Which team won the UEFA European Football Championship 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Italy**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** 16th edition** of the** quadrennial international men's football tournamen**t of **Europe, the UEFA European Football Championship, **took place in** 2020.**
 
• The **Union of European Football Associations **organized it.
 
• After a **1-1 deadlock** in overtime,** Italy defeated England** on penalties to claim their **second European Championship championship.**
 
• The victory occurred precisely **39 years **after **Italy defeated West Germany** in the **1982 FIFA World Cup Final.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **22nd FIFA World Cup**, which was held in **2022**, was an **International football competition.**
 
• It was the first World Cup to be staged in the** Arab and Muslim worlds.**
 
• It was held in** Qatar** from **20 November to 18 December 2022.**
 
• After defeating the **defending champion France **in the championship game, **Argentina **was declared the victor.
 
• Argentina won its** third championship**, it's** first since 1986,** and became the **first non-European country** to do so **since 2002.**
 
• The first player to** score a hat-trick** in a World Cup final was **Kylian Mbappé of France.**
 
• He also took home the** Golden Boot** for scoring the **most goals (eight) overall** during the competition.
 
• The best player in the competition was** Lionel Messi,** the Argentine captain, **winning the Golden Ball.**
